title: review code edits / Provide feedback and request revisions
content: ## Provide feedback and request revisions You can ask the agent to revise its work from any review workflow. Send a follow-up prompt, edit the files directly, or provide inline feedback in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. ### Provide inline feedback to the agent 1. In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, open a file from the **Changes** view. 1. Select a range of code in the diff, and enter feedback in the inline comment box. 1. Add feedback to other changes as needed, and then select **Submit Feedback** to send all comments to the agent. The agent reads your comments, makes the requested edits, and resolves each comment. Resolved comments disappear from the diff view. ### Add pull request review comments `feature(agents-window-pr-comments)` In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, publish review comments to a session's open GitHub pull request when it uses the {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} or Claude harness, or the [experimental Codex integration](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#codex). 1. Enable the `setting(chat.experimental.agentsWindowPRComments)` setting. 1. Open a changed file from the **Changes** view and select a range of code. 1. Select **Add Feedback** and enter your comment. 1. Select **Add PR Comment** to publish the review comment. If the session is associated with multiple pull requests, the action identifies the target as `owner/repository#number`. The selected range must contain only lines that are part of the pull request diff. If the range isn't eligible, {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} reports that a pull request comment can't be added to the line. **Add PR Comment** publishes the comment to GitHub and doesn't send it to the agent. To request a code change, add the comment as feedback and select **Submit Feedback**. ### Get a second opinion with Rubber Duck `feature(rubber-duck)` In a [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness session](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#copilot), Rubber Duck uses a complementary model to review plans, code, and tests for substantive issues. It is read-only and doesn't edit files or run commands that change your environment. The harness might consult Rubber Duck automatically during non-trivial work. To request a review yourself, ask: ```prompt Get a second opinion on the changes made so far. ``` You can also enter `/rubber-duck `, such as `/rubber-duck What edge cases are missing?`. The harness summarizes the critique and decides how to act on it. > [!NOTE] > Rubber Duck requires a Claude or GPT model in the main session and an available complementary model. The additional model pass adds latency and model usage. Learn more about the [Rubber Duck agent](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/copilot-cli/rubber-duck).
